entities.summary: George Anthony Stanich is an American former multi-sport athlete who won a bronze medal at the 1948 Summer Olympics in high jump. He played college basketball for the UCLA Bruins, where he was a two-time all-conference player in the Pacific Coast Conference. He is the brother of John Stanich.
